|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-kylorenscommandshuttle-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-kylorenscommandshutt022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/kylorenscommandshuttle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/kylorenscommandshuttle.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “''Lambda''-class Shuttle”. Text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May deploy to exterior sites. When deployed, may deploy Kylo aboard (deploy -2) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Takes off and lands for free.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-kylorenscommandshutte8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/kylorenscommandshuttle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/kylorenscommandshuttle.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the icons beside the game text were changed (re-drawn and re-ordered); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “''Lambda''-class Shuttle”. It is the current image. Text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May deploy to exterior sites. When deployed, may deploy Kylo aboard (deploy -2) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Takes off and lands for free.”
